items.title: 1.6.2 Applications of Design Patterns in Software Design (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of applications of design patterns (PDF 26).

blocks.text: Design patterns software development mein aam masle hal karne aur mazboot (robust) aur aasani se sambhalne wala (maintainable) code banane ke liye bohat istemal hote hain. Yeh in cheezon mein madad karte hain:

items: Saaf banawat (clear structure) de kar code ki pecheedgi (complexity) kam karna.
Aazmaye hue hal istemal kar ke code ka dobara istemal (reusability) barhana.
Developers ko ek jaise alfaaz (common vocabulary) de kar un ki aapas ki baat cheet behtar karna.

blocks.text: Design patterns aise systems banane mein madad karte hain jo lachakdar (flexible), aasani se sambhalne wale (maintainable) aur samajhne mein aasan hon.

blocks.title: Did You Know? (Kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Bohat se mashhoor software frameworks aur libraries design patterns se bane hain. Misal: Model-View-Controller (MVC) pattern Ruby on Rails aur Angular jaise web development frameworks mein istemal hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Design patterns developers ki aapas ki baat cheet kaise behtar karte hain?
blocks.explanation: Yeh poore hal ko ek naam de dete hain: 'yahan Observer laga do' kehne se poori team ko foran poora design samajh aa jata hai.

items: Design patterns: complexity kam, reusability zyada, baat cheet behtar; flexible aur maintainable systems.
MVC pattern Ruby on Rails aur Angular mein istemal hota hai.
